title: New-Order Days' Supply for Tailwise Pharmacy Prescription Diets
content:
*Pharmacy dispensing basis, prescription diets.*

A new Tailwise Pharmacy order for a prescription diet asks for 30 days' supply per fill, never more than the class's maximum days' supply per fill, in whole days. The class maximum is the figure the fill-limits schedule sets for Rx Prescription Diet.

## Restated

| Element | Value |
|---|---|
| Days' supply per fill asked for on a new prescription diet order | 30 days |
| Upper limit | the class's maximum days' supply per fill |
| Unit | whole days |

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A customer orders a renal diet for a second cat. The order asks for 30 days' supply per fill; the Rx Prescription Diet maximum per fill, as the schedule states it, is not exceeded, so 30 days stands.
